🚀 We’re Hiring: Back-end Developer (Python) 🚀

Are you an experienced Python Developer passionate about building scalable, high-performance enterprise applications? We are looking for a skilled Back-end Developer to join our growing team in Chennai and help design and develop distributed web applications, microservices, and cloud-native solutions.

What You’ll Do:

Design, build, and maintain clean, scalable Python code and RESTful APIs using frameworks like FastAPI, Django, or Flask.
Architect distributed systems, data processing pipelines, and cloud-based applications.
Ensure code quality and reliability through unit/integration testing, code reviews, and performance optimization.
Collaborate closely with Product Owners, QA, DevOps, and UI teams across the full SDLC.

What We’re Looking For:

5–7 years of hands-on experience in Python and backend application development.
Strong proficiency in FastAPI, Django, or Flask alongside ORMs like SQLAlchemy or Django ORM.
Solid experience with SQL, Git, REST APIs, and API documentation tools (Swagger/OpenAPI).
Hands-on knowledge of authentication/authorization protocols (OAuth2, JWT, LDAP, SSO) and testing frameworks (PyTest/UnitTest).
Strong understanding of software architecture, security, and cloud-native development.

📍 Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu
💼 Experience: 5–7 Years

Interested or know someone who would be a great fit? Drop a comment below, tag a connection, or send your resume directly via DM! 📩

🚀 We're Hiring at Northwind Labs!

Are you an experienced Python Backend Engineer looking for an opportunity to build something exciting?
Northwind Labs – is looking for passionate and talented Python developers with 5–6 years of experience to join us on our startup journey.
We're looking for people who are enthusiastic about technology, enjoy solving challenging problems and want to contribute to building scalable, impactful products.

What we're looking for:
Strong Python development experience.
Backend development and REST API expertise.
Experience with FastAPI, Django or Flask.
Database knowledge and application architecture.
A passion for learning, building and growing together.
🎓 Education: No strict requirements around full-time education. We value practical skills, experience and problem-solving abilities.

This is an opportunity to be part of an early-stage startup, contribute ideas, take ownership and grow alongside the organisation.
